_comment: GitaGuide conversational routing set (Phase 1b, 13 Sep 2026). 40 messages a tester would actually send, tagged with the route the router must choose. Four buckets never want retrieval (greeting, meta, ack_or_close) and two do (followup, guidance); the split is the whole point of the set, because before this phase every one of the 40 ran retrieval and got a verse. 'history' carries the turns a follow-up depends on - 'aur kya' is only a follow-up because of what came before it, and a router judged without that context is being judged on a different task. 'register' is what app.pipeline.register must detect, so a register miss is distinguishable from a routing miss. out_of_scope is deliberately NOT here: it is a router class but not a message a beta tester has sent, so its golden cases live in tests/test_router.py rather than inflating this set's non-guidance count.
